text.tspan: Prompt panels show one authentic example; percentages summarize the whole archived topic (duplicates retained). Probability = exp(stored log probability); no A/B renormalization.
* Opposite-option treatment probabilities were not saved. These complements are illustrative approximations, not recovered measurements. pp = percentage points.
The archive labels this example Climate Change. The manuscript labels it environmental protection; its displayed percentages differ from these data-derived results.
